title: Feature Map Entry Frontmatter
description: Frontmatter of one feature file in a repo's feature map (.agents/skills/factory-features-<project>/features/<id>.md). The checker resolves every code and test anchor against the project root or a neighbor. Unknown keys are ignored with a warning.

status.description: planned = designed but not in code yet; anchors may point at the code it will extend

summary.description: One sentence a user would recognise; an agent matches a request against it

aliases.description: Other names people use for the feature

covers.description: Inventory ids from the map's scripts/inventory.mjs that this feature accounts for

pending_pr.description: The open PR this entry already describes. While set, an anchor that does not resolve is a warning naming the PR. scripts/clear-pending-prs.mjs --apply removes it once the PR merges.

app_recipe.description: Replayable route into the running app, relative to the map directory. Replayed by the map's scripts/replay-app.mjs; the checker runs it with --check.

last_verified.description: Date the feature was last driven live (not last edited), or "never"

repo.description: The project's name or a neighbor's name (factory-context). Omit for the repo that holds the map.

path.description: File or directory relative to that repo's root; never a line number

symbols.description: Identifiers or string literals that must appear in the file

role.description: What to change here, in a few words
